mapper.select: SELECT e.equip_code AS equipCode, e.equip_name AS equipName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prod_check_row r JOIN prod_check_sheet s ON s.sheet_id = r.sheet_id WHERE s.equip_code = e.equip_code AND s.prod_date = #{date}) AS rowCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.part_no) FROM prod_check_row r JOIN prod_check_sheet s ON s.sheet_id = r.sheet_id WHERE s.equip_code = e.equip_code AND s.prod_date = #{date} AND r.part_no IS NOT NULL AND r.part_no <> '') AS partCount FROM base_equipment e WHERE e.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY e.equip_id

SELECT s.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prod_check_row r WHERE r.sheet_id = s.sheet_id) AS row_count, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(r.qty_kg), 0) FROM prod_check_row r WHERE r.sheet_id = s.sheet_id) AS qty_sum, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(r.defect_qty), 0) FROM prod_check_row r WHERE r.sheet_id = s.sheet_id) AS defect_sum, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prod_check_row r WHERE r.sheet_id = s.sheet_id AND r.down_code IS NOT NULL AND r.down_code <> '') AS down_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prod_check_sign g WHERE g.sheet_id = s.sheet_id) AS sign_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.check_row_id) FROM quality_hardness_meas m JOIN prod_check_row r ON r.row_id = m.check_row_id WHERE r.sheet_id = s.sheet_id AND m.judgement = '불합격') AS ng_count FROM prod_check_sheet s WHERE s.equip_code = #{equipCode} AND s.prod_date >= #{from} AND s.prod_date <= #{to} ORDER BY s.prod_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prod_check_sheet (equip_code, prod_date, reg_user_id, reg_user_name) VALUES (#{equipCode}, #{prodDate}, #{regUserId}, #{regUserName})
mapper.update: UPDATE prod_check_sheet SET worker_day = #{workerDay}, worker_night = #{workerNight}, qc_name = #{qcName} WHERE sheet_id = #{sheetId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM prod_check_row r LEFT JOIN quality_nonconform n ON n.nc_id = r.nc_id WHERE r.sheet_id = #{sheetId} ORDER BY r.row_no, r.row_id
SELECT FROM prod_check_row r LEFT JOIN quality_nonconform n ON n.nc_id = r.nc_id WHERE r.row_id = #{rowId}
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(row_no), 0) FROM prod_check_row WHERE sheet_id = #{sheetId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prod_check_row (sheet_id, row_no, out_time, vendor, part_no, product_name, spec_text, lot_no, qty_kg, material, heat_lot_no, worker, leader, qc) VALUES (#{sheetId}, #{rowNo}, #{outTime}, #{vendor}, #{partNo}, #{productName}, #{specText}, #{lotNo}, #{qtyKg}, #{material}, #{heatLotNo}, #{worker}, #{leader}, #{qc})
mapper.update: UPDATE prod_check_row SET out_time = #{outTime}, vendor = #{vendor}, part_no = #{partNo}, product_name = #{productName}, spec_text = #{specText}, lot_no = #{lotNo}, qty_kg = #{qtyKg}, defect_qty = #{defectQty}, defect_code = #{defectCode}, down_code = #{downCode}, down_start = #{downStart}, down_end = #{downEnd}, material = #{material}, heat_lot_no = #{heatLotNo}, worker = #{worker}, leader = #{leader}, qc = #{qc}, downtime_id = #{downtimeId}, nc_id = #{ncId} WHERE row_id = #{rowId}
UPDATE prod_check_row SET row_no = #{rowNo} WHERE row_id = #{rowId}
mapper.select: SELECT m.check_row_id AS rowId, m.meas_id AS measId, m.spec_id AS specId, m.item_name AS itemName, m.judgement AS judgement, v.idx AS idx, v.value AS value FROM quality_hardness_meas m JOIN prod_check_row r ON r.row_id = m.check_row_id LEFT JOIN quality_hardness_set s ON s.meas_id = m.meas_id LEFT JOIN quality_hardness_value v ON v.set_id = s.set_id WHERE r.sheet_id = #{sheetId} ORDER BY m.check_row_id, m.item_name, v.idx
SELECT * FROM quality_hardness_meas WHERE check_row_id = #{rowId} AND item_name = #{itemName}
mapper.update: UPDATE quality_hardness_meas SET check_row_id = #{rowId} WHERE meas_id = #{measId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM prod_check_sign WHERE sheet_id = #{sheetId} AND slot = #{slot}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prod_check_sign (sheet_id, slot, user_id, sign_name, sign_img, sign_dt) VALUES (#{sheetId}, #{slot}, #{userId}, #{signName}, #{signImg}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM prod_check_sign WHERE sheet_id = #{sheetId} AND slot = #{slot}
mapper.select: SELECT setting_key AS k, setting_value AS v FROM prod_check_setting
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prod_check_setting (setting_key, setting_value) VALUES (#{key}, #{value}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE setting_value = VALUES(setting_value)

INSERT INTO prod_check_audit (sheet_id, equip_code, prod_date, row_id, row_no, part_no, target, action, changes, user_id, user_name, client_ip) VALUES (#{sheetId}, #{equipCode}, #{prodDate}, #{rowId}, #{rowNo}, #{partNo}, #{target}, #{action}, #{changes}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{clientIp})
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, e.equip_name FROM prod_check_audit a LEFT JOIN base_equipment e ON e.equip_code = a.equip_code WHERE a.prod_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND a.equip_code = #{equipCode} ORDER BY a.reg_dt DESC, a.audit_id DESC LIMIT 3000

SELECT s.sheet_id AS sheetId, s.equip_code AS equipCode, e.equip_name AS equipName, s.prod_date AS prodDate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prod_check_row r WHERE r.sheet_id = s.sheet_id) AS rowCount FROM prod_check_sheet s LEFT JOIN base_equipment e ON e.equip_code = s.equip_code WHERE s.prod_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND s.equip_code = #{equipCode} ORDER BY s.prod_date DESC, e.equip_id

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.part_no AS partNo, p.product_name AS productName, p.spec AS specText, p.material AS material, v.vendor_name AS vendor, p.charge_weight_kg AS chargeWeightKg, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base_hardness_spec h WHERE h.product_id = p.product_id AND h.equip_code = #{equipCode} AND h.use_yn = 'Y') AS specCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base_pattern t WHERE t.product_id = p.product_id AND t.use_yn = 'Y') AS patternCount FROM base_product p LEFT JOIN base_vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.vendor_id WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY p.part_no
